title: Russian Strike on Pavlohrad Shopping Center Kills 4, Injures Over 60
detail: Russian forces struck a shopping center in central Pavlohrad, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, around midday on September 10, killing 4 people and injuring more than 60, including three teenage boys aged 13, 14, and 15, Interior Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi said. The casualty toll rose in stages as emergency crews worked the scene — from 2 killed and 18 injured in the first report to a final count of 4 killed and 60+ injured. Emergency services said a drone struck first, followed less than an hour later by guided aerial bombs, damaging vehicles, retail units, and shops and sparking multiple fires; two State Emergency Service employees were also injured responding. Pavlohrad, about 75 kilometers from the front line, had been considered relatively safe until a first glide-bomb attack hit the city on July 20. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the strike was intended to 'inflict maximum casualties, spread fear' among civilians.

title: Ukraine Strikes Russia's Caspian Port at Makhachkala and Warships Near Novorossiysk
detail: Ukraine's General Staff confirmed overnight strikes on September 9-10 against the Makhachkala Commercial Seaport in Russia's Republic of Dagestan — Russia's only ice-free deep-water port on the Caspian Sea, roughly 750 kilometers from the Ukraine border, used as a transit point for Iranian-made attack drones and connecting Russia to Iran — as well as fuel-oil storage facilities near Novorossiysk. Ukrainian Defense Forces also reported hitting three Russian naval vessels — the Zheleznyakov minesweeper, the Admiral Essen frigate, and the Project 11711 landing ship Pyotr Morgunov. Fires were reported at the Makhachkala port's oil terminal and depot. President Zelensky said the strikes were part of a wave hitting eight Russian infrastructure targets that day, including facilities in Moscow, Voronezh, Astrakhan, and Bryansk regions, saying 'Russia continues its terror against Ukraine every day. And every day it receives a fair response.'
